sections.h2: Which office records a deed in Barren County, Kentucky?
sections.html:
The Barren County Clerk records deeds and mortgages for land in Barren County. The office is in the Barren County Government Center on the north side of the square, at 117 North Public Square, Suite 1A, Glasgow, KY 42141, and the phone is 270-651-3783.

Kentucky requires a deed to be filed in the county where the land lies (KRS 382.110), so a house in Cave City, Park City, Glasgow or out in the Barren River Lake area is recorded in Glasgow no matter where the seller lives. The clerk's Legal Records Division also collects delinquent real estate taxes, which matters to anyone selling a house with back taxes.

sections.h2: What kind of county is Barren County for a home seller?
sections.html:
Barren County was formed in 1798 and covers about 500 square miles in south-central Kentucky, with Glasgow as the seat and largest city. Interstate 65 crosses the northwest corner, the Cumberland Expressway also serves it, and US 31E, 31W and 68 also pass through it. Mammoth Cave National Park lies partly in the county, which keeps lodging and restaurants busy around Cave City.

  • Population estimate for 2025: 45,641, up 2.6 percent from the 2020 count.
  • Median value of owner-occupied housing: $178,000 (2020 to 2024 Census survey).
  • Owner-occupied rate: 65.2 percent across 18,017 households, so about a third of occupied homes are rentals.
  • Median household income: $50,628; median gross rent: $796.
  • Housing units: 20,957 as of July 2025.

Three school districts serve the county: Barren County Schools, Glasgow Independent Schools and Caverna Independent Schools. A buyer asking which district a house falls in is a routine question, and a deed's legal description is the document that settles the parcel's location.

sections.h2: How much does it cost to record a deed at the Barren County Clerk?
sections.html:
The clerk posts the statewide minimum fee schedule effective January 1, 2020. Most documents list a $3 charge for each page past the fifth, and mortgages add $3 for each page past the thirtieth. The office cites KRS 64.012 and House Bill 537 as the source of the schedule.

Barren County Clerk minimum recording fees, as posted for January 1, 2020 (barren.countyclerk.us)

On top of the clerk's fee, KRS 142.010 charges a $4 state tax on each conveyance of real property that the clerk collects. Ask the counter for a single total before you write the check.

sections.h2: Why does the Barren County Clerk reject deeds?
sections.html:
The clerk lists the reasons a document gets sent back, and most of them are avoidable. A deed that bounces can delay a closing by days.

  • The document is not notarized, or the notary left off an expiration date or the date of notarization.
  • The filing fee is wrong or the check is unsigned.
  • The title source is incomplete, or there is no legal description of the property.
  • The deed has no in-care-of address for the property tax bill.
  • The grantor or grantee mailing address is missing.
  • A copy was submitted where an original is required.
  • A power of attorney lacks two disinterested witnesses, a rule the clerk ties to KRS 457.050 effective July 15, 2018.

The in-care-of address and the full consideration statement come from KRS 382.135, and the title-source rule is KRS 382.110. A closing attorney usually catches these items, but a seller who prepared a deed alone should check the list.

sections.h2: What transfer tax applies to a Barren County sale?
sections.html:
Kentucky taxes the seller fifty cents for every $500 of value in the deed, rounded up for any part of $500 (KRS 142.050). On a sale at the county's median home value of $178,000, the value spans 356 units of $500, so the tax would be $178.00.

The clerk computes the tax and refuses the deed until it is paid. Deeds that merely correct a prior deed, secure or release a debt, follow a foreclosure, or move property between spouses are exempt, as are parent to child transfers for nominal consideration. If the transfer is a gift, the declared value is the price the home would bring on the open market.

sections.h2: How do delinquent taxes and liens show up in Barren County?
sections.html:
Because the clerk's Legal Records Division collects delinquent real estate taxes, an unpaid bill is a clerk matter in Barren County once the sheriff's collection season ends. Kentucky's Department of Revenue explains that unpaid bills move to the county clerk after the close of business on April 15, where they become certificates of delinquency and a lien is recorded against the property. Interest of 1 percent a month then starts, and the county attorney and clerk each add a percentage fee.

Under KRS 134.015, taxes are due by December 31 of the assessment year, a 2 percent discount applies through November 1, and a 5 percent penalty starts in January. A seller should ask the clerk for a payoff figure before the closing date, since the amount grows each month.

sections.h2: Does the local economy change how fast Barren County houses sell?
sections.html:
Agriculture is the county's main industry, Glasgow is its manufacturing, medical and retail center, and Cave City lives on visitors to Mammoth Cave. In February 2026 a data-center equipment maker announced a $76 million plant in Glasgow expected to bring 400 manufacturing jobs, the largest job announcement in the county in nearly two decades. New jobs tend to lift demand for rentals and starter homes near Glasgow, while farmland and lake properties on the county's edges move on a different timetable.

For a seller, the practical point is that two parcels in the same county can need different paperwork. A farm may carry several tracts and an old plat, and a Cave City lodging lot may have easements. Each of those documents is recorded at the clerk and priced at the fees in the table above.

sections.h2: How do you search Barren County land records online?
sections.html:
The clerk's online land records run through eCCLIX, a subscription service from Software Management, LLC. The monthly plan has a $200 one-time setup fee, $65 a month, and $10 for each added user. A single-day pass costs a $45 setup fee and $15 per 24 hours. People without an account can come to the office and view records at no charge.

The clerk also offers DocAlert, a free service that emails you when a mortgage or deed is filed under your name or your business name. For a landlord with several parcels or an heir to land they do not live near, that notice is a cheap way to spot a forged deed.

E-recording is available through three vendors, which closing agents use to file without a trip to the square: CSC at (866) 652-0111, Simplifile at (800) 460-5657, and ePN at (888) 325-3365.

sections.h2: What should a Barren County seller line up before closing?
sections.html:
• Find the book and page of your own deed so the new deed can cite it.
  • Ask the clerk whether a delinquent tax certificate or lien is recorded against the parcel.
  • Gather the mailing address where the buyer wants the tax bill.
  • Confirm who will e-record or deliver the original deed to Glasgow.
  • Check any inherited parcel for an affidavit of descent, which the clerk lists at $50.

Sellers with a vacant or inherited Barren County house who would rather skip repairs can request a cash offer, and the buyer's closing agent then handles the same recording steps.

faqs.q: Where is the Barren County Clerk's office?
faqs.a: It is at 117 North Public Square, Suite 1A, in Glasgow, inside the Barren County Government Center. The posted phone number is 270-651-3783.

faqs.q: How much is the minimum fee to record a deed in Barren County?
faqs.a: It is $50 for a deed, with $3 more for each page after the fifth. KRS 142.010 adds a $4 state tax on conveyances, so ask the clerk for the full total.

faqs.q: Does Barren County accept electronic recording?
faqs.a: Yes. The clerk lists CSC, Simplifile and ePN as e-recording services, so a title company can file a deed without delivering paper to Glasgow.

faqs.q: What happens if my deed has no tax-bill address?
faqs.a: The clerk can send it back. KRS 382.135 requires an in-care-of address for the current year's property tax bill, and the clerk's rejection list names a missing address as a common reason.

faqs.q: Is there a way to be warned about a fake deed on my land?
faqs.a: Yes. Register for DocAlert through the Barren County Clerk's website with your name and email. It emails you whenever a deed or mortgage is recorded under that name.
